name: Input verified Unicode text into an editable field
description: Input CJK and other Unicode text into one editable field via the controlled Helper IME: record the current IME, switch, input Modified UTF-7 encoded text, verify by UI Tree read-back (NFC exact match) and always restore the previous IME. Sensitive digit shapes are rejected before any device action.

submit.description: After verified input, press the field IME search/enter action once.
